messages:
ashley: Opening expedited hotfix for encoder routing causing ~2.5% 5xx on /embeddings for long inputs. Built image encoder:v1.9.3-hotfix. No DB changes. Requesting short lifeboat rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) in the next 20m. /cc @mike_ops @oncall-jess

mike_ops: pls post deploy link + rollback steps and confirm smoke tests.

ashley: deploy: https://deploy.internal/redwood/deploys/1753217777. Smoke tests green in staging. Rollback plan:
```
# rollback to previous image
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/encoder encoder=redwood/encoder:v1.9.2
# pin previous to release-config to avoid auto-redeploy
curl -X POST https://release-config.internal/pin -d '{"service":"encoder","version":"v1.9.2","reason":"rollback"}'
```
No kv-cache changes. I'll add a short playbook to #eng-oncall.

deploybot: Deploy request received for encoder:v1.9.3-hotfix. CI: \u2705 unit, \u2705 integration, e2e flaky. Proposed canary: 10% for 5m, auto-pause if error_rate > 1% for 2m. Reply "approve" or react :thumbsup:.

oncall-jess: I'll be on pager and watching metrics for 45m. +1 to expedited path if we keep the 5m gate and rollback owner ready.

mike_ops: +1, I'll be on rollback duty. Setting circuit-breaker threshold to 1% and tail-latency alert +10%.

deploybot: Canary started at 1753217785 -> encoder:v1.9.3 @10%. Link: https://deploy.internal/redwood/deploys/1753217777/canary

ashley: monitoring dashboard: https://grafana.company/d/encoder/health. If error_rate >1% for 2m auto-pause and alert ops.

oncall-jess: 3m into canary: error_rate 0.2%, p95 stable. Proceeding to 50% for 3m.

deploybot: Ramp to 50% at 1753217815.

mike_ops: steady. p95 +1%, error_rate 0.1%. ready to finish.

deploybot: Rollout to 100% completed at 1753217830.

ashley: No rollback needed. Publishing release note RN-489 now. Thanks for the quick approvals. :rocket:
